newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Guangzhou Inv offers 61.2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Inv offers 61.2 mln shares.

text.p: Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd said on Thursday it was offering 61.2 million new shares at Hong Kong $2.555 each in its secondary listing on the Singapore stock market.
The company said in a statement that 6.8 million shares will be offered to the public and 54.4 million will be placed out.
Guangzhou will have a right to increase the number of shares in the public tranche by up to another 6.8 million shares in case of oversubcription.
The new shares represent 2.39 percent of the company's enlarged issued capital.
The IPO will raise HK$146 million which will be used mainly to finance progress payments of its two infrastructure projects, a road-toll project and a bridge, in Guangdong province, China.
The application for shares opens on October 18 and will close on October 21. The HK dollar denominated shares will be traded in board lots of 2,000 shares.

Guangzhou Investment is the Hong Kong-listed investment and trading arm of the Guangzhou Municipal Government. It has interests ranging from infrastructure and property developments to cement production and paper manufacturing.
